Area.evidence_source: When suicidal thoughts had developed into planning the suicide, the participants stopped the planning because they did not want to leave family members behind. Ian said he had organised the suicide and thought carefully about the method. He recounted, 'You start to wonder, for example about family members'. Henry said he had planned to jump from a balcony. He said, 'I think I was standing there for perhaps an hour when I decided not to give up, I did not want to, I did not want to leave my boy'. David talked about feeling better and better as he organised his suicide in more detail. He attended to all loose ends so that nothing would become a burden on those left behind and felt calmer. After attaining some resulting peace, he decided not to go through with the plan.
